control: the key is generated jointly by the holders of an epoch; no party holds or ever computes the whole key
custody: each holder keeps its own share; the controller of the key context holds no share

secret: one share per holder, never published

enforcement.decryption: threshold shares: a release needs a contribution of every holder
enforcement.evaluation: admission only: anybody can compute on the ciphertexts with the public evaluation key; only an admitted and accepted result becomes an object of the scope
enforcement.history: a holder of a later epoch holds no share of an earlier one
enforcement.exit: a holder that leaves keeps its share of the epochs it was in; a later epoch is generated without it
